Test262 switch and parameter environments > switch creates its lexical environment after the discriminant
code:
let item = "outside"
        let discriminantRead
        let selectorRead
        let statementRead
        switch ((discriminantRead = () => item, null)) {
          case (selectorRead = () => item, null):
            statementRead = () => item
            let item = "inside"
        }
        return [discriminantRead(), selectorRead(), statementRead()]

test: Test262 switch and parameter environments > all switch cases share one lexical environment that closes afterward
code:
let item = "outside"
        let firstRead
        let secondRead
        switch (null) {
          case null:
            let item = "inside"
            firstRead = () => item
          case null:
            secondRead = () => item
        }
        return [firstRead(), secondRead(), item]
